statement.en: forall x y s, (x in s -> x = y) -> x in s -> x = y
statement.ja: forall x y s, (x in s -> x = y) -> x in s -> x = y

script:
theorem impl_example : forall x y s, (x in s -> x = y) -> x in s -> x = y.
intros x y s H.
split.
- (* x in s *)
  admit.
- (* x = y *)
  apply H.
  admit.
qed.

explanation.en:
With the intros tactic, you do not need to repeat intro several times.

intros x y.

performs the same actions as intro x. intro y..

intros.

repeats intro as many times as possible, assigning names automatically.
explanation.ja:
タクティク intros を使うとintroを何度も繰り返す必要がなくなります．

intros x y.

でintro x. intro y.と同じ動作をします．

intros.

で，名前を自動的に付けた上で intro が可能な限り繰り返されます．

progress.en:
When we have a hypothesis H : P -> Q and the conclusion is Q, we can use

apply H.
progress.ja:
仮定に H : P -> Q があり，結論が Q のとき，

apply H.

が適用できます．

progress.en: The conclusion has changed. From here, we can complete the proof using the methods we have already learned.
progress.ja: 結論が変わりましたね．ここからはこれまでの方法で証明が完了します．
